sloka: यद् अग्नि दायके पापम् यत् पापम् गुरु तल्पगे ।मित्र द्रोहे च यत् पापम् तत् पापम् प्रतिपद्यताम् ॥२-७५-४५॥
transliteration: yad agni dāyake pāpam yat pāpam guru talpage ।mitra drohe ca yat pāpam tat pāpam pratipadyatām ॥2-75-45॥

translations.english: May that one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person who sets fire to human settlements, violates the preceptors's bed and betrays his friend
